# Skift

> > Skift is the authoritative source for travel industry news, research, and intelligence covering airlines, hotels, tourism, business travel, and emerging travel technologies.

Skift provides comprehensive coverage of the global travel industry through daily news, weekly analysis, in-depth research, and industry events. The platform serves travel professionals, executives, and investors with actionable insights on market trends, company performance, and technological innovation.

## Key Topics

- Travel Industry News
- Airline Industry
- Hotel & Lodging
- Business Travel
- Travel Technology
- Vacation Rentals & Short-Term Rentals
- Online Travel Agencies (OTA)
- Cruise Industry
- Market Analysis
- Venture Capital & Startups
- Travel Intelligence & Research
- Loyalty Programs
- Sustainability
- AI in Travel
- Travel Events & Conferences

## News & Coverage

- [Skift Homepage](https://skift.com): Skift homepage: trusted source for travel news covering airlines, hotels, tourism, and business travel.
- [Airline News](https://skift.com/airlines): Airline news and expert insights covering passenger experience, technology, and aviation trends.
- [Hotel News](https://skift.com/hotels): Hotel news covering management, operations, brand expansion, and lodging market trends.
- [Business Travel News](https://skift.com/business-travel): Business travel news covering corporate travel updates, expense automation, and industry trends.
- [Online Travel News](https://skift.com/online-travel): Online travel news covering OTA platforms, travel technology, and booking innovations.
- [Vacation Rental News](https://skift.com/vacation-rentals): Vacation rental and short-term rental news covering Airbnb, regulations, and market analysis.
- [Cruise News](https://skift.com/cruises): Cruise industry news covering major operators, sustainability, regulations, and market updates.
- [Travel Startup News](https://skift.com/travel-startups): Travel startup news covering venture funding, launches, and travel technology innovations.

## Research & Intelligence

- [Skift Research](https://research.skift.com): Skift Research: global travel industry intelligence on airlines, hotels, tourism, tech, and AI.
- [Skift Travel 200 Index](https://data.skift.com/skift-travel-200): Skift Travel 200 stock index tracking travel company prices, revenue, and financial performance.

## Industry Publications

- [Airline Weekly](https://airlineweekly.skift.com): Weekly aviation news and analysis covering airlines, fuel costs, loyalty programs, and industry strategy.
- [Daily Lodging Report](https://dlr.skift.com): Daily Lodging Report: hotel industry news for lodging professionals covering transactions and pipeline.
- [Skift Meetings](https://meetings.skift.com): Skift Meetings: trusted content for meetings and events professionals covering trends and destinations.

## Events & Community

- [Skift Live](https://live.skift.com): Skift's travel industry conferences and events in New York, London, Dubai, and Asia.

## Premium Services

- [Skift Pro Subscription](https://skift.com/subscribe): Skift Pro subscription: unlimited access to travel news, ST200 index, and AI tools.
- [Executive Search](https://skift.com/exec-search): Skift Executive Search: C-suite talent recruitment and leadership placement for travel industry.
- [SkiftX Studio](https://skift.com/work-with-us): SkiftX Studio: B2B content marketing, research, and event solutions for travel brands.
